caption: The drawing features two views of a hat, presented on a plain, light beige background. The upper object shows a top-down view of a woven, circular hat with concentric patterns in shades of brown and tan. Around the crown of the hat, there is a distinctive decorative band in the form of black zigzag patterning arranged in a gear-like formation with evenly spaced rectangular projections. The lower object displays the same hat from a side perspective, highlighting its dome-shaped crown and downward curving brim. The black zigzag band is visible encircling the crown, repeating the same gear-like design as seen from above. Both views depict the texture and woven construction with fine, detailed lines and shading to indicate depth and material.
title: Child's Hat
